CREATE VIEW GOLD.Calendar 
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
                BULK 'https://praneethstorageacc.blob.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar',
                FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
                ) AS QUERY1;
